articles.title: Meet the first new living cat species described in more than a century
articles.snippet: Genetic tests on two of these teeny tiger cats, found in Bolivia, show they constitute a new species. They add a new branch to the feline family tree.

articles.title: Eruption Extends Iwo Jima’s Beach

articles.title: Studying Cancer Cells in Microgravity
articles.snippet: This Nov. 19, 2026, image shows gastric microtumors grown within an Encapsulates biochip. The Encapsulate-1 investigation studies patient-derived tumor samples aboard the International Space Station to better understand how cancer cells move and interact in microgravity. The results could help researchers develop further testing to predict a patient's risk of metastasis and support more...
